notes: DCA Fourth Round Obligation of 297 units accepted by Resolution R25-72 (Jan 21, 2025). HEFSP filed BER-L-000525-25 on 06/12/2025 (52 pages). Planner: Burgis Associates (Joseph H. Burgis PP AICP, David Novak PP AICP). Fourth Round RDP is zero (no newly vacant parcels ≥ 0.83 acres). Present Need reduced 68→10 via Structural Conditions Survey (Dec 11, 2024); DCA figure of 68 used in obligation fields per DCA source. Fourth Round plan credits: 53 affordable units from 6 sites (Table 22). Amended HEFSP adopted Feb 11, 2026 (BER-L-000525-25, 59 pages) added additional overlay sites and revised densities. Third Round RDP obligation 501 units; prior round unmet need 48 units.

sites.quote: The site, which is identified by municipal tax records as Block 1301 Lots 1 and 3, is located at 121-131 North Summit Street. On May 24, 2023, the site received preliminary and final site plan approval as well as 'c' variance relief for a mixed use development consisting of 2,470 square feet of retail space as well as one hundred and twelve (112) multifamily units, including seventeen (17) affordable units. One (1) of these affordable units is to be applied to the Borough's Third Round RDP obligation, while the remaining sixteen (16) units are to be applied to the Fourth Round.
sites.notes: 17 total affordable units; 1 applied to Third Round RDP, 16 to Fourth Round. Site plan approved May 24, 2023. Not yet constructed as of HEFSP adoption.

sites.quote: 31 Central Avenue. 31 Central Avenue, which is identified by municipal tax records as Block 1104 Lots 7 and 8, received site plan approval in 2023 for a mixed-use development consisting of ten (10) residential units.

sites.address: Intersection of West Clinton Avenue and Tenafly Road, Tenafly, NJ
sites.proposed_zoning: 100% affordable senior housing (deed restriction extended via PILOT amendment)
sites.quote: The Tenafly Senior Housing Site is identified by municipal tax records as Block 1008 Lot 2. It is located at the intersection of West Clinton Avenue and Tenafly Road. The Tenafly Senior Housing Site was constructed in 1983 as a Federal Housing Administration Section 202 senior housing project. The facility consists of thirty-four (34) units occupied by very-low, low- and moderate-income senior households. ... the Borough will apply ten (10) of the thirty-four (34) credits towards its Third Round RDP obligation. The remaining twenty-four (24) will be utilized in the Fourth Round.
sites.notes: 34 total units; 10 credited to Third Round RDP, 24 to Fourth Round. Deed restriction extended via PILOT amendment. Age-restricted (senior) housing.

sites.quote: The 33 Engle Street Site is located in the southerly portion of the Borough, to the south of the intersection of Engle Street and Elm Street. The site, which is identified by municipal tax records as Block 2006 Lot 7, is located at 33 Engle Street. It has an area of 0.75 acres and is somewhat rectangular in shape. The Borough has rezoned this property from the R-7.5 District to a new MF-I-2 District which will permit multifamily development at a density not to exceed 12 units per acre. This will permit the development of eight (8) multifamily units, including two (2) affordable units.
sites.notes: Block/lot from amended Feb 2026 HEFSP. Rezoning ordinance attached as Appendix M of amended HEFSP.

sites.address: Intersection of West Clinton Avenue and Franklin Street, Tenafly, NJ
sites.quote: The West Clinton Avenue Overlay Site is located near the center of the Borough's downtown. The site, which is identified by municipal tax records as Block 904 Lots 3, 4, 5, and 6, is located at the intersection of West Clinton Avenue and Franklin Street. It has a collective area of approximately 1.28 acres and is irregular in shape. The Borough has adopted a new AHO-9 Affordable Housing Overlay District to encapsulate this site. This overlay district will permit the development of thirteen (13) multifamily units, including three (3) affordable units.
sites.notes: Block/lot from amended Feb 2026 HEFSP. AHO-9 ordinance attached as Appendix N of amended HEFSP. Also permits small-scale commercial development along West Clinton Avenue.
